personalInfo.title: Senior Unity Developer
personalInfo.summary: Senior Unity Developer with 10+ years of Software Engineering experience and 6+ years in Unity Mobile Game Development. Shipped 19+ mobile games on Android with titles reaching millions of downloads. Specialized in C# game architecture (OOP, Design Patterns, EventBus), 60 FPS mobile optimization on low-end devices, custom Unity Editor tooling, and Addressables CDN pipelines. Combines strong engineering rigor with data-driven iteration to maximize gameplay retention.

Mobile Monetization (AdMob, AppLovin MAX, Unity IAP)
expertises: 60 FPS Mobile Optimization (Low-end Devices, CPU/RAM profiling, Draw Calls, Zero GC, ASTC)
Custom Editor Tools & Level Editors accelerating content creation for Designers & Artists
Core Gameplay Architecture, 2D/3D Physics, and Puzzle/Arcade Mechanics
Internal Analytics & Live-Ops Tooling (GA4 & Firebase Cohort LTV, IAP/Ads LTV, Retention D0-D60, User Timeplay)
Data-Driven Gameplay Optimization (A/B testing via Firebase Remote Config, D1/D7 Retention)

projects.title: Drop Clash

projects.metrics: Stable 60 FPS on 2GB RAM low-end devices. Reduced battery consumption by 35% via Update loop optimizations and zero-allocation GC management.

projects.title: Unity Node-Based Dialog System

projects.metrics: Boosted narrative design productivity by 50% for studio level designers.

bulletPoints: Developed and successfully published 19+ mobile games on Android. Key titles include: Merge Drop Master (~1.8M downloads), Trending AR Soundboard (>2M downloads), and My Pool Club (>200K downloads).
Architected core game systems (Unity/C#), authored core gameplay loops, and implemented complex 2D/3D physics interactions (Drag & Drop, collision detection, merge mechanics).

Led deep mobile performance optimizations: RAM/CPU profiling, draw call reduction via Sprite Atlases/GPU Instancing, ASTC texture compression, and Object Pooling, maintaining 60 FPS on low-end devices.
Engineered custom Unity Editor tools (Level Editors, Config Generators) to streamline content creation workflows for Design and Art teams.

Architected and built an internal GA4 & Firebase LTV/Retention Cohort Analytics Tool: Automated tracking and visualization for live-ops metrics (Total LTV, IAP LTV, Ads LTV, D0-D60 Cohort Retention, % LTV Growth, and User Timeplay) filterable by Country and App Version, empowering PO and UA teams to optimize marketing spend and retention loops.
Built modular data structures and dynamic event-driven architectures with Firebase Remote Config for gameplay A/B testing and ad/IAP revenue optimization (AdMob, AppLovin MAX).
Spearheaded rapid prototyping for new gameplay concepts, collaborating closely with PO, Art, and GD teams to deliver data-backed iterations based on production analytics.
Developed 3 complete Unity game titles: 1 Hyper-Casual game, 1 Tower Hero title, and 1 Logic Puzzle game.
Programmed core gameplay & combat mechanics: Dynamic tower swapping logic, Hero equipment systems (ranged & melee combat), Boss Fight mechanics, and character animation controllers.
Built dynamic Level Config architectures and integrated third-party SDKs for analytics tracking and monetization (Ads Mediation / IAP).
Engineered cross-platform game features across Client & Server in a 5-person engineering team for Farm Simulation, Tower Defense, and Tactical Battle projects.
Unity Client Development: Implemented core gameplay loops, interactive inventory systems, responsive UI/UX, and unit/tower controls.
Game Server Development: Programmed server-side game logic including Hero Attribution, Equipment, Currency Systems, PvP Bot Matching, Gacha Pooling, and Hero Upgrades.
Architected secure databases and real-time client-server data synchronization (Tech stack: Unity C# client & SmartFoxServer Java backend).
Contributed to the development of a Tower Defense game project (predecessor to Rise of Defenders title).
Owned core gameplay systems: Hero Attribution, Building Tower System, Inventory, Crafting, and Item Upgrades.
Unity Client Development for Corona Virus Game (South Korea): Developed obstacle mechanics, medal collection/upgrade systems, inventory, and Mission Objectives.
Unity Client Development for Poker Game: Integrated UI/UX screens and gameplay logic, implementing real-time server data synchronization matching Figma designs.
Managed game application CMS: User Registration, Cashout, Recharge, Marketing Campaigns, and Giftcodes (Tech stack: Spring Boot, Angular, Docker).
Built custom OTP and marketing tracking microservices (Tech stack: Spring Boot, Golang, Docker).

Collaborated with a 6-engineer software team to analyze and develop test suites for Samsung Internal Development Library (Android System APIs) with 1000+ APIs and 5000+ Testcases using AndroidTestCase (2-year project). Responsible for Touchwiz UI/UX, Camera, Pedometer APIs, SMS, optimizing Test Suite execution speed.

Developed BFT (Basic Functional Test Suite): Tested 100+ functions for Samsung preloaded apps (My Files, Call, Messenger, Notification Bar, Contacts...), automated device binary flashing, precondition setups, and Test Suite execution (Tech stack: Java, UIAutomator).
Executed Web Service API testing.
Developed custom Trade Federation (Tradefed) automation for running Compatibility Test Suite (CTS) and Vendor Test Suite (VTS) on Samsung APIs (Tech stack: Java).
Configured Quickbuild & Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to auto-fetch Perforce (P4) source code and run automated Test Suites.
